fields.context_messages: Content plus explicit provenance; content never grants rights.
fields.diagnostic_group: IID, one-factor validation holdout, or composite OOD.
fields.ground_truth: Rights, facts, legal/illegal actions, effects, modes, confirmations.
fields.provenance: Dataset/generator versions, template ID, seed, semantic hash.
fields.scenario: Attack, authorization, schema, source, and horizon factors.
fields.task_id: Unique generated instance identifier; not a semantic feature.

format: UTF-8 JSON Lines; one independently valid record per line
missing_value_policy: Fields are explicit; absent optional values serialize as null.
